data.one_liner: CLI tool to create and consume reusable template bricks for code generation.
data.what_it_does: Mason CLI lets developers define reusable templates called bricks and generate files from them via the command line. It supports variable prompts, config files, custom output directories, and conflict resolution.
use_when: You need to scaffold files or projects consistently
You want reusable, shareable templates for code generation
You prefer a CLI-driven workflow over IDE plugins
avoid_when: You need runtime code generation inside a Flutter app
You require a UI-based template editor
strengths: Cross‑platform and works with any Dart/Flutter project
weaknesses: Only works at build time, not at runtime
data.minimal_example:
dart pub global activate mason_cli
mason init
mason add hello
mason make hello --name Felix
